data.name: Aadila
data.gender_notes: Aadila is used as a female name.
data.long_meaning: Aadila (عادلة) is the feminine of ʿādil, meaning 'just, fair, upright' — a woman who acts with justice. It comes from the root ʿ-d-l, the root of ʿadl (justice).
data.spiritual_meaning: The name holds up justice as its ideal; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: Feminine of Arabic ʿādil, from ʿadala, 'to act justly'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadila total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aadila mean?
faq.a: Aadila means Just; fair; upright (feminine of ʿādil).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aadila?
What language does the name Aadila come from?
faq.a: Aadila is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aadila a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadila is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aadila written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aadila is written عادلة in Arabic and عادلہ in Urdu, and आदिला in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aadila?
faq.a: The root of Aadila is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aadila?
faq.a: Feminine of Arabic ʿādil, from ʿadala, 'to act justly'.

faq.q: Does Aadila appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿādilah is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʿ-d-l.
Aadila is the feminine of ʿādil, meaning 'just, fair, upright'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aadila?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadila total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aadila?
faq.a: Aadila appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Adila, Aadilah.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aadila?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aadila include Aadil, Aadilah.
Yes. Aadila is the feminine form of the masculine Aadil; both come from the root ʿ-d-l.

faq.q: Where is the name Aadila used today?
faq.a: Aadila is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
